description: A spawned subagent child: --mode json --task-id t1 --max-turns 2. stdout starts with a {"ping":true} heartbeat, then the session header, then only the events the parent pool consumes (turn_end, tool_execution_start/end, message_end). Turn 1 (a read tool call) crosses the 90% wrap-up mark, so the steer message reaches the model in turn 2's request; turn 2 hits the cap, so result.json reports a partial result with the session's token usage.
